0022600086.text: Washington hosts Milwaukee in a regular-season game where both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and the Wizards are missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), all listed as out. The Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 109-99 win in Washington on January 29, 2026. No games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
